name: Souhaib GARAAOUCH
headline: Data Engineer
summary: I am a data engineer. My focus is pipelines. I have worked on several systems over the years and I would like to bring my experience to your organization, where I believe my background in data modeling and my analysis skills will be a good fit for the team and the center of your roadmap.

items.heading: AI Engineer
bullets: Responsible for the data pipeline and the modeling of the warehouse.
Duties included writing SQL and analysing the results.
Worked on the center of the platform.
Helped with the labeling of the training data.
Travelled to the plant to collect sensor data.
Cancelled the legacy export after the migration.
Delivered a report with [METRIC?] records processed.
